comparison.objective: Remove an old toner cartridge, insert a new one on printer guide rails, and close the door; candidate configures a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Handle large cartridges through keyed rails and notches while avoiding a roller versus fine two-tool countertorque and angular adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Old cartridge safely placed, new cartridge seated, door shut, hands clear, and state stable for one second; printer movement, roller contact, or drops fail.
comparison.reason: Guided consumable extraction and insertion do not overlap meaningfully with jam-nut locking or repeated stop verification.
